known_nonblocking_external_or_out_of_sco.finding: The proxy receives 405 from /v1/responses/input_tokens and falls back to its local tokenizer.
known_nonblocking_external_or_out_of_sco.impact: Log noise and a small token-counting overhead; chat and retrieval requests still return 200 and the final acceptance conversation completed.
known_nonblocking_external_or_out_of_sco.reason_not_changed: This is inside the upstream LiteLLM runtime rather than WeKnora parsing or retrieval code; changing it safely requires an upstream LiteLLM version/runtime change.
known_nonblocking_external_or_out_of_sco.workaround: Keep local-tokenizer fallback enabled and monitor the upstream LiteLLM fix.
